title: Doubling Machine
brief: Let's build your very own function, a reusable machine you can call again and again! Your Doubling Machine takes a number, doubles it, and hands the answer back with return. Finish the double() function so it returns the number times 2, run it, then press Check Project to test a few numbers.
steps: Look at the function double(number). Right now it just says pass, so it hands nothing back.
Replace the pass line with return number * 2 so the function returns the doubled value.
The bottom part already asks for a number, calls your function, and prints the answer.
Run it and try a number, then press Check Project.
starterCode:

# This part asks for a number and uses your function:
n = int(input("Give me a number to double: "))
answer = double(n)
print("Doubled:", answer)
inputHint: Type one number for the machine to double.
successMessage: Boom! 🔢 You built a real function that takes a number in and returns an answer, then reused it on any number. That's exactly how programmers avoid writing the same code over and over!
